# SenseAgri AI

> Poultry intelligence for South African operations, founded 2025. Unifies house sensors — temperature, humidity, CO₂, ammonia, feed, water and eggs — into welfare and disease early warnings on WhatsApp, and weekly ROI reports. Hardware-agnostic across Big Dutchman, SKOV and DOL-class sensors. Sells a proof of concept and a Partner Programme (sensors, dashboard and install) to farms and to feed, vet and integrator partners.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.senseagriai.com/): product overview and positioning.
- [Solution](https://www.senseagriai.com/solution): how the platform works end-to-end — sensing in the house, edge AI on the farm, decisions on your phone.
- [Pricing](https://www.senseagriai.com/pricing): Partner Programme at founder pricing — hands-on partnership with direct access to the team, scoped per operation.
- [About](https://www.senseagriai.com/about): the company, mission ("digital husbandry for African farms"), founders, values.
- [Contact](https://www.senseagriai.com/contact): book a demo with the team.

## Facts

- **Product**: SenseAgri AI (also referred to as SenseAgri Farm AI in some alerts).
- **Category**: SaaS / intelligence platform for commercial poultry operations.
- **Geography**: Based in South Africa; targets African poultry operations.
- **Delivery**: web dashboard + WhatsApp alerts.
- **Signals monitored**: temperature, humidity, air quality (CO₂, ammonia), feed, water, hen-day production, welfare indicators.
- **Founders**: Dylan Geldenhuys (Co-Founder & CEO, data scientist), Dr Ryan Nel (Co-Founder & COO, veterinarian).
- **Contact**: ryan@senseagriai.com
- **LinkedIn (company)**: https://www.linkedin.com/company/senseagri-ai/
